notes: Manufacturer datasheet (https://files.cyberdata.net/assets/011209/011209_SIP_Emergency_Intercom.pdf) confirms: Ethernet I/F 10/100 Mbps; Power Input = PoE 802.3af compliant OR +8 to +12VDC @ 1000mA regulated supply (not included); On-Board Relay 1A @ 30VDC. Audio Output 86dB@1m, payloads G.711a/u, G.722, G.729; surface-mount plastic enclosure, 4.53 x 2.22 x 4.53 in, indoor use only — no rackUnits (desktop/surface-mount device). The device's non-network I/O (alternate DC power, relay dry-contact, door-sense input) live on an internal multi-pin terminal block shown in an installation diagram (8 numbered terminals) but the datasheet/operations guide does not publish a labeled pin table, so exact pin numbers and precise connector style (screw terminal vs. pluggable Euroblock) are inferred — mapped to the closest listed ids (euroblock-dc for DC power, euroblock for relay/sense). No integrated speaker/mic external connectors are broken out (audio transducers are built into the enclosure, not exposed as external ports). "Category/type": no listed `type` enum cleanly matches a SIP door/emergency intercom, so type is omitted; category set to "audio". Model number 011209 corresponds specifically to the wall-surface-mount red "EMERGENCY / PRESS BUTTON TO CALL" intercom (also sold in gray/other colors under related SKUs in the same product family per the Operations Guide part-number list: 011186, 011209, 011211, 011214, 011216, 011304, 011305, 011309, 011567 — those are different physical enclosures/features but share this core I/O).

ports.name: DC Power In
ports.note: Alternative to PoE: +8 to +12 VDC @ 1000mA regulated supply (not included), wired into the device's internal terminal block. Exact connector style not pictured in datasheet; terminal-block wiring inferred from installation diagram.

ports.name: Relay Out (Door Strike)
ports.note: On-board DTMF-controlled dry relay contact, 1A @ 30VDC, normally-open; switches an externally supplied DC source to trigger an electric door strike. Part of the same multi-pin terminal block shown in the install diagram; exact pin numbering not published.

ports.name: Sense Input
ports.note: Door closure / tamper sense input wired to the terminal block (labeled "Sense Input" in the installation diagram, used with an externally supplied door sensor).
